title: Local models of integral constructible complexes and their cohomology
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k_0$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and a chosen uniformizer $\pi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the completed coefficient sheaf $\mathcal O_{E,X}$ of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and the bounded-constructible cohomology definition of $\Dbc$ in [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $K\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.

1. There is a finite stratification of $X$ such that on each stratum $S$,
   pro-étale locally on $S$, $K|_S$ is the completion
   $\widehat{\underline{M^\bullet}}=M^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_{E,S}$
   of a bounded complex $M^\bullet$ of finite free $\mathcal O_E$-modules, with
   differentials given by matrices over $\mathcal O_E$.
2. Each cohomology sheaf $H^q(K)$ is derived complete, lies in
   $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$, and on each stratum of (1) is pro-étale locally the
   completion of the finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module $H^q(M^\bullet)$.
3. Every truncation $\tau_{\le q}K$, $\tau_{\ge q}K$ lies in
   $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.

proof.text: Normalize coefficient monoid instances by their definitional equality. The existing integral constant-model heart theorem supplies truncation constructibility and the degree-zero constructibility of every cohomology module.

The scheme is Noetherian by finite type over a field. Apply the projective local-model transport lemma. Each projective scalar term embeds in a free module and is torsion-free; since the scalar DVR is a PID and the term is finite, Mathlib makes it free without changing the complex or support bounds.

On exactly these charts use integralHeartRealization_exact_free and exact cartesian inverse image. Compose the derived-functor cohomology isomorphism with the chosen model isomorphism, the Q-to-complex homology isomorphism and exact scalar realization homology. Cycles embed in a finite term over a Noetherian PID; homology is their quotient and is finite.
Apply the constructible-module Roos-completeness lemma to H^q(K). Combine its completeness with degree-zero constructibility and the two truncation assertions from the first step.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (1)--(3), exact-functor assembly with two coefficient comparison steps
